results.title: The Other Side of Reality
results.overview: Fifty years after the brutal disappearances of Martial Law, a mother reunites with her missing son through virtual reality—only to confront how technology turns personal grief into spectacle, and history into a commodity.

results.title: The Time That Never Came
results.overview: In a world obsessed with youth, Sara chose to age naturally while Oskar, her partner, took an anti-aging treatment. Years later, when they reunite — divided by time but bound by the past — Sara begins a journey to reclaim lost love, confront buried emotions and find freedom.

results.title: Carta a uma Jovem Escritora
results.overview: Carta a Uma Jovem Escritora is a reflection on memory and forgetting, presented through five striking portraits of five Portuguese women writers: Olga Gonçalves, Graça Pina de Morais, Maria Cecília Correia, Alice Sampaio, and Maria Amélia Neto.

results.title: De volta à Bahia
results.overview: A video of a young surfer's rescue goes viral on the internet, revealing the unexpected encounter between Maya (Bárbara França) and Pedro (Lucca Picon), two promising surfing talents. Introduced by PH (Felipe Roque), a surfing idol, they are surprised to discover they are already connected by the rescue that went viral—and that both are trained by the same mentor. While preparing for a crucial championship in Salvador, they face family conflicts and experience a romance.

results.title: Well Done Girls
results.overview: Follows former world champion rock climber Sasha DiGiulian and her climbing partner Mariana "Mango" Ordoñez as they attempt to complete a thrilling mission in Madagascar that was initiated in the 1990s by their climbing idols. The film weaves fun present-day climbing action with archival footage of the original expedition led by the legendary Lynn Hill, highlighting the legacy of women pushing boundaries in a demanding sport with their own styles and personalities.

results.title: Le cinéma de Terry Gilliam - L’imagination au pouvoir
results.original_title: Le cinéma de Terry Gilliam - L’imagination au pouvoir
results.overview: Bandits, Bandits, Brazil, Munchausen, Twelve Monkeys, not to mention the crazy Monty Python saga... With their visual extravagance and ever-fresh originality, amplifying his vision of a humanity that is as disturbing as it is comical, his films have made history. In the same baroque, zany, but also tragic vein, Terry Gilliam's work and life merge into an adventure that borders on the epic.

results.title: Pretty Girls Kill
results.overview: Twenty years after witnessing her friends death, a woman must face her killers in their demonic state.

results.title: The Last Shuttle
results.overview: With Earth nearing collapse, a hardened scavenger discovers a lost mute girl whose family may offer their only hope of escape, forcing him to choose between self-preservation and redemption.

results.title: Crías
results.overview: In the lowest of the literary underworld, forgotten, our teenage diaries live badly. Crías builds an archive with these invisible writings, imagines ways to dialogue with him and collects his destruction. A feminist film-zine that alchemizes personal shames through communal discourses, while reconciling with the process of writing and rewriting life, diary work and creative work. We live by counting on each other.

results.title: Claire McKenna
results.overview: After years of addiction and isolation, Claire McKenna is finally home from rehab. It’s her first day back—and her first day of probation.  Anxiously awaiting her parole officer, Claire discovers something from her old life that suddenly puts her fragile new beginning into question.  To everyone around her, the moment may seem insignificant. For Claire, it’s a fierce and deeply personal battle to remain sober, honest, and alive.

results.title: The Brutal Alchemy of Water
results.overview: Refusing to accept the loss of her girlfriend, Quinn spirals through the suffocating confines of prison. In the depths of her grief she must navigate her unraveling mind and confront her inner demons.

results.title: Юрий Бутусов. Барабаны внутри
results.overview: For its creators, this film became, in a sense, a labor of love and duty. *Yuri Butusov: Drums Within* is a film about the director’s talent, his confrontation with reality, his mission, and love. Those featured in the film—Butusov’s students, actors who worked with him, his former classmates, close associates, and his "gang"—were unanimous: knowing and working with him was never, and could never have been, just another project. He changed the people he met and transformed the space around him; he would stir things up and create a swell of energy—making the whole cauldron boil. Yet, often enough, he himself found himself powerless against that very tide. Making a film about such a man—avoiding the trap of turning him into a monument and ensuring the result was anything but banal—was a formidable challenge for the filmmakers. They worked on the project for over a year, gathering a wealth of rare archival material and interviewing dozens of people.

results.title: Interlude
results.overview: Following a failed suicide attempt, Clara is in a coma and discovers that the afterlife is a giant Scrabble tournament. It all makes no sense, and yet, she must win the competition to overcome her demons.

results.title: Sajen Satu Suro
results.overview: Tania (Aisyah Aqilah) returns to Maduabang Village with Jeff (Cinta Brian Glenn Roberts), Laura (Frislly Herlinda Balqis), and Robby (Munggaran Meldrat). They plan to return the heirloom keris belonging to her grandfather, Sapto Dilogo (Clift Sangra), in order to cure her mother, who is suffering from a mysterious illness. Their arrival with the keris stirs up the villagers’ fears that the spirit of Sumarni (Assila Corina ) has returned. The bride-to-be was murdered by Sapto Dilogo with that very keris. Tania and her friends find themselves caught up in the revenge plot of Suparti (Yurike Prastica) and Aryoseno (Harris Syaus), which is closely tied to a past tragedy that occurred on the night of 1 Suro. Amid supernatural terror and a series of attacks that claim victims, Tania finally uncovers the dark truth about her family.

results.title: Miss Matched
results.overview: After a messy divorce, an architect who believes his rare skin condition makes him undateable hires a quirky matchmaker—sparking a partnership that forces them both to rewrite their rules on love.

results.title: 31 Minutos, desde el Zócalo de la Ciudad de México: Yo Nunca Vi Televisión
results.original_title: 31 Minutos, desde el Zócalo de la Ciudad de México: Yo Nunca Vi Televisión
results.overview: The acclaimed cast and crew of Chile’s ‘31 minutos’ perform in front of more than 230,000 spectators at Mexico City’s Zócalo, on Thursday, April 30, 2026.

results.title: JC The University
results.overview: A ten-year journey traces Madhusudan, aka Maddy, from a middle-class final-year degree student into the dark worlds of jail and the underworld

results.title: Nawab Cafe
results.overview: A family grapples with communication barriers as a father and son circle around conversations they desperately need but cannot bring themselves to have.
